items.heading: Explains that if the clothing of the upper light is in the reflected light of the level of Hochma, all ten Sefirot will be in the light of Hochma. And if in the level of Bina, all ten Sefirot will be in the light of Bina. And if in the level of Zeir Anpin, all ten Sefirot will be in the light of Zeir Anpin. And if in the level of Malchut, all ten Sefirot will be in the light of Malchut. And it contains four matters: — 1. When Ein Sof shines in Bina of Atzilut, it does not shine by clothing in the reflected light of the screen of Bina, rather the light of the level of Hochma shines there in Bina as well. Therefore even Zeir Anpin, who receives from Bina, also has the light of Hochma. 2. But to shine in the world of Beria, it clothes in the reflected light of the screen of Bina, therefore all ten Sefirot are the light of Bina, even the Keter and Hochma that are there. 3. And so in the world of Yetzira, it clothes in the reflected light of the screen of Zeir Anpin, and all ten Sefirot are from the light of Zeir Anpin. And so in the world of Asiya, which clothes in the screen of the level of Malchut, all ten Sefirot are in the light of Malchut, even the Keter, Hochma, and Bina of Zeir Anpin that are there. 4. The four letters Yod, Hei, Vav, Hei allude to the four worlds ABYA. — When Adam Kadmon clothed to shine in Atzilut, it clothed only in the reflected light of the level of Hochma alone, and not in the reflected light of the second discernment, which is the level of Bina, therefore only the Keter was concealed from this level, and Keter clothed within Hochma.
items.html: 1And indeed know, that when the Emanator wished to shine in Atzilut, He clothed in the Hochma that is above Atzilut, and by means of the Hochma in which He is clothed within it, He then entered and shone in the Keter and Hochma of Atzilut, and did not need to also clothe in the Bina that is above Atzilut, and clothed only in the Hochma that is above Atzilut alone, 2and through it He shines in the Keter and Hochma of Atzilut.

items.heading: Bina transmits through a window the light of the level of Hochma, to Zeir Anpin and Malchut, without a second clothing in the reflected light of the screen of the second discernment.
items.html: And indeed, 3when He wished to shine from Bina of Atzilut onward to the end of all Atzilut, then 4certainly He needed to clothe also in Bina of Atzilut, for 5Zeir Anpin and Nukva receive light only by means of Bina, but the matter is, 6that Bina served only as a passage alone for the light of Ein Sof clothed within the aforementioned upper Hochma, and it passed through Bina to Atzilut, 7and Bina did not become a screen and a second garment in order to shine to Zeir Anpin, rather the light itself came 8through a window, as above, without any screen at all. And it follows that although it is drawn through Bina, this is not called clothing, since there is no screen there at all, and thus it is the very light of Ein Sof, clothed in Hochma alone, that ZA and Nukva of Atzilut receive.

items.heading: To shine in the world of Beria, the upper light clothes in the reflected light of the level of the second discernment, which is Bina. And it follows that Hochma, too, is concealed, and Keter and Hochma are included within Bina.
items.html: But 9in Beria, Ein Sof clothes in another garment in Bina of Atzilut, and this 10Bina becomes a sealed screen and a complete garment, through which all ten Sefirot of Beria receive, even the Keter and Hochma of Beria.

items.heading: The uppermost Sefira in every level of the ten Sefirot shines in all ten Sefirot of that level, such that in the world of Atzilut all ten Sefirot in it receive the light of Hochma, and in the world of Beria all ten Sefirot receive the light of Bina.
items.html: It follows that Atzilut receives the light of the supernal Hochma, since Ein Sof clothes within it, and thus 20it is considered as receiving only from Hochma alone. And Beria receives the light of Bina, since 30Ein Sof and Hochma clothe within it, and thus Beria receives only from Bina alone, and this is the secret of 40"the supernal Ima nests in the throne," for the throne receives light from the aforementioned Bina of Atzilut, since a separating screen is made between Ein Sof and Hochma toward Beria.

items.heading: Bina of Atzilut transmits to ZA and Nukva the light of Hochma. Bina of Beria transmits to ZA and Nukva the light of Bina.
items.html: And if you say, if so then Zeir Anpin and Nukva of Atzilut and of Beria are all equal, since all receive from Bina of Atzilut, one should say that we have already explained that Zeir Anpin and Nukva receive the very light of Hochma, for all was made in Hochma, and Bina serves them only as a passage in general; but after Atzilut, Bina becomes a screen and a complete garment from the exterior of the vessel of Bina of Atzilut, and through this screen all ten Sefirot of Beria receive the light of Ein Sof.

items.heading: Zeir Anpin of Beria transmits to Malchut the light of Bina.
items.html: And know, that also in Beria, although the light returned to clothe in Zeir Anpin of Beria, nevertheless the Malchut of Beria, too, receives the very light of Bina of Atzilut itself, 50and Zeir Anpin does not interpose for it, but only by way of passage alone, similar to what was said regarding Atzilut, and so it is 60in the particulars of Yetzira from within itself, and so in the particulars of Asiya from within itself.

items.heading: In the world of Yetzira, the upper light clothes in the reflected light of the first discernment, which is the level of Zeir Anpin. And in the world of Asiya, the upper light clothes in the reflected light of the level of the root of coarseness, which is the level of the Nukva of Zeir Anpin.
items.html: And behold, Ein Sof, in order to shine in Yetzira, clothes in 70a complete garment also in Zeir Anpin of Beria, and it becomes a screen and a garment for Yetzira, and through it all of Yetzira receives. And so to shine in Asiya, Ein Sof clothes in a complete garment and screen in the Nukva of Zeir Anpin of Yetzira as well, and through it all of Asiya receives, and this is the secret of 80"six Sefirot nest in Yetzira," 90and the lower Ima nests in the Ofan.

items.heading: ABYA is the secret of the four letters Yod, Hei, Vav, Hei. Yod is Atzilut, which is Hochma. Hei is the secret of Beria, which is Bina. Vav is the secret of Yetzira, which is Zeir Anpin. The last Hei is Asiya, which is Malchut.
items.html: And here you will understand why the four worlds 100Atzilut, Beria, Yetzira, Asiya, are alluded to in the four letters of the Havaya: Yod is Atzilut, Hei is Beria, Vav is Yetzira, Hei is Asiya. For 200the light of Atzilut is by means of the supernal Hochma as above, therefore it is called Yod. And Beria is by means of Bina of Atzilut, therefore it is called Hei. And so Vav in Yetzira. And so in Asiya, the lower Hei.

items.heading: The general conclusion is that the main difference between one world and another of ABYA is according to the screens of the four discernments of coarseness of Hochma, Bina, Tiferet, and Malchut.
items.html: It follows now, as a general conclusion, that Atzilut receives light from Hochma alone, since Hochma becomes a sealed screen between Ein Sof and Atzilut; and from Bina of Atzilut, Beria receives, after the light of Ein Sof and the supernal Hochma clothed within it, and nevertheless it is called the light of Bina, since it became a complete separating screen; and so Yetzira receives from Zeir Anpin of Beria itself, and so Asiya receives from the Nukva of Zeir Anpin of Yetzira itself, 300and were it not for all these screens and garments, they would not be able to receive the upper light, only that each world is lower in degree than its fellow, in the manner mentioned above.
